notes.title: Crumble Party v 1.1.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Known Issues:
If the player clicks Roll Dice before the map appears, the player temporarily pops up underground, and then is moved back to the proper spot.
When playing Mini-game using speed miner, cake slices don’t carry over to the board game. 
Upgrade Shop - Should only display UNIQUE items with no duplicates.
Slow down the text on the mini game tutorial.
Remove QR Code from main menu. 
Add visual representation for Low-High quality button effects in the settings
Player icon doesn't show in aerial view while choosing move direction.
Mouse switches out of the stylized cursor when returning to board game sometimes
Some transitions have the player hovering backwards
Board adjustments to prevent players from missing Start Tile

Planned New Content:
Halbert Attacks - Midgame surprise to improve game experience
Increase mini-game difficulty over play time
Multiplayer with CPU Players
Online and Local Multiplayer
Town Member “Quests” - NPC Optional Content
Create a Game mode where you can just play the mini game
New Upgrade: Extra Turn - Grants you an extra turn to give you more time to save the town
Add Controller support
Steam Achievements
